1.text: “Ntimugacire abandi urubanza mu mitima yanyu kugira ngo namwe mutazarucirwa,

2.text: kuko urubanza muca ari rwo muzacirwa namwe, urugero mugeramo ari rwo muzagererwamo namwe.

3.text: Ni iki gituma ubona agatotsi kari mu jisho rya mwene so, ariko ntiwite ku mugogo uri mu jisho ryawe?

4.text: Cyangwa wabasha ute kubwira mwene so uti ‘Henga ngutokore agatotsi mu jisho ryawe’, kandi ugifite umugogo mu jisho ryawe?

5.text: Wa ndyarya we, banza wikuremo umugogo uri mu ryawe jisho, kuko ari bwo wabona uko utokora agatotsi mu jisho rya mwene so.

6.text: “Ibyejejwe by'Imana ntimukabihe imbwa, kandi n'imaragarita zanyu ntimukazite imbere y'ingurube, kugira ngo zitaziribata maze zikabahindukirana zikabarya.

7.text: “Musabe muzahabwa, mushake muzabona, mukomange ku rugi muzakingurirwa.

8.text: Kuko umuntu wese usaba ahabwa, ushatse abona, n'ukomanga agakingurirwa.

9.text: Mbese muri mwe hari umuntu umwana we yasaba umutsima akamuha ibuye,

11.text: Ko muri babi kandi mukaba muzi guha abana banyu ibyiza, none So wo mu ijuru ntazarushaho guha ibyiza ababimusabye?

12.text: “Nuko ibyo mushaka ko abantu babagirira byose mube ari ko mubagirira namwe, kuko ayo ari yo mategeko n'ibyahanuwe.

13.text: “Munyure mu irembo rifunganye, kuko irembo ari rigari, n'inzira ijyana abantu kurimbuka ari nini, kandi abayinyuramo ni benshi.

14.text: Ariko irembo rifunganye, n'inzira ijya mu bugingo iraruhije, kandi abayinyuramo ni bake.

15.text: “Mwirinde abahanuzi b'ibinyoma baza aho muri basa n'intama, ariko imbere ari amasega aryana.

16.text: Muzabamenyera ku mbuto zabo. Mbese hari abasoroma imizabibu ku mugenge, cyangwa imbuto z'umutini ku gitovu?

17.text: Nuko igiti cyiza cyose cyera imbuto nziza, ariko igiti kibi cyera imbuto mbi.

18.text: Igiti cyiza ntikibasha kwera imbuto mbi, kandi n'igiti kibi ntikibasha kwera imbuto nziza.

19.text: Igiti cyose kitera imbuto nziza kiracibwa, kikajugunywa mu muriro.

21.text: “Umuntu wese umbwira ati ‘Mwami, Mwami’, si we uzinjira mu bwami bwo mu ijuru, keretse ukora ibyo Data wo mu ijuru ashaka.

22.text: Benshi bazambaza kuri uwo munsi bati ‘Mwami, Mwami, ntitwahanuraga mu izina ryawe, ntitwirukanaga abadayimoni mu izina ryawe, ntitwakoraga ibitangaza byinshi mu izina ryawe?’

23.text: Ni bwo nzaberurira nti ‘Sinigeze kubamenya, nimumve imbere mwa nkozi z'ibibi mwe.’

24.text: “Nuko umuntu wese wumva ayo magambo yanjye akayakomeza, azaba nk'umunyabwenge wubatse inzu ye ku rutare,

25.text: imvura iragwa, imivu iratemba, umuyaga urahuha, byose byikubita kuri iyo nzu ntiyagwa, kuko yari ishinzwe ku rutare.

26.text: “Kandi umuntu wese wumva ayo magambo yanjye ntayakomeze, azaba ari nk'umupfapfa wubatse inzu ye ku musenyi,

27.text: imvura iragwa, imivu iratemba, umuyaga urahuha, byose byikubita kuri iyo nzu iragwa, kandi kugwa kwayo kwabaye kunini.”

28.text: Yesu amaze kuvuga ayo magambo yose ba bantu batangazwa no kwigisha kwe,

29.text: kuko yabigishaga nk'ufite ubutware, ntase n'abanditsi babo.
